rabbittools.description.core:
§5§nINSTALLATION§0§r
Put your new core together with your wand in a crafting grid to install it. To switch between cores, hold down %s and left click empty space with your wand or use the option screen.
rabbittools.description.core_angel: The angel core places a block on the opposite side of the block (or row of blocks) you are facing. Maximum distance depends on wand tier. Right click empty space to place a block in midair. To do that, you'll need to have the block you want to place in your offhand.
rabbittools.description.core_destruction: The destruction core destroys blocks (no tile entities) on the side facing you. Maximum number of blocks depends on wand tier. Destroyed blocks disappear into the void, you can use the undo feature if you've made a mistake.
rabbittools.description.core_exchange: The exchange core replaces blocks on the side facing you (or a row of blocks) with the block held in your offhand. Maximum number of blocks depends on wand tier. Restrictions work just like with the Construction core.
rabbittools.description.void_sack:
The Void Sack intercepts items you pick up and stores them in its 4×4 internal inventory.

§5§nACTIVATION§0§r
Press %1$s to activate or deactivate the sack. While inactive, items go to your normal inventory as usual.

§5§nLINKING A CONTAINER§0§r
Right-click any container (chest, barrel, shulker...) while holding the sack to link it. Once linked, items go to that container first when the sack is active. If the container is full, the overflow goes to the sack's internal storage.

§5§nTOGGLE MODE§0§r
Press %1$s to switch between §aSending§0 (items → container) and §eStoring§0 (items → internal slots). You can also click the toggle button inside the sack GUI.
rabbittools.description.wand:
The %1$s can place up to %2$d blocks at the side of a building facing you and lasts %3$s.

Hold down %5$s and scroll to change placement restriction (Horizontal, Vertical, North/South, East/West, No lock).

Open the option screen with %6$s§9+Right click§0.

§5§nUNDO§0§r
Holding down §9Sneak+§0%4$s while looking at a blocks will show you the last blocks you placed with a green border around them. §9Sneak+§0%4$s§9+Right clicking§0 any of them will undo the operation, giving you all the items back. If you used the Destruction core, it will restore the blocks.

§5§nCONTAINERS§0§r
Shulker boxes, bundles and many containers from other mods can provide building blocks for the wand.

§5§nOFFHAND PRIORITY§0§r
Having blocks in your offhand will place them instead of the block you're looking at.
